name: @sos-2/orchestrator-host
description: SOS 2.0 Orchestrator Host (Work Order P6): the plain Node + TypeScript composition root of the Spirit Orchestrator (the apps/api + apps/worker-runtimes precedent — no vendor framework). THE SINGLE IMPURE BOUNDARY: this app injects the clock and the ports (the documented system-clock module is the only Date.now in the app; the DETERMINISTIC demo main runs on a ManualClock at a fixed instant — the demo state is explicitly simulated, never presented as live). The composition assembles the in-memory durable P2 stores, the Body Broker (with the P8 reference cloud bodies registered), the Execution Fabric, the durable Task Graph, the Reasoning Broker (managed default ALWAYS present — the demo journey runs with ZERO bring-your-own providers configured: a user never needs a personal LLM to start), the worker runtime, the independent verifier, the AskQueue and the ArchitectGate, and runs the orchestrator loop on an INJECTED TICK SOURCE (a bounded finite source — no ambient timers). The demo main executes a deterministic three-lane journey end-to-end: mission -> decomposition -> 3 concurrent lanes on disjoint owned-path scopes -> crash + recovery of one lane (explicit deterministic simulated crash injection) -> verification-gated completion (no self-approval) -> architect-gated mission completion -> honest report with explicit simulated markers.
